objective: Refit the postflop parameters actually consumed by Model A continuation while preserving hidden-hand uncertainty, street-to-street combo coherence, and an independent VALIDATION-only retain/promote decision.

public_features: street/context encoded by exact canonical node

stage_a_response_refit.out_of_support_policy: MATCH_RUNTIME_CLIPPING; facing_price_pot<=5 and spr<=50; clipped observations counted
stage_a_response_refit.hidden_hand_policy: ADMISSIBLE because this stage uses public/action context only; no private hand is invented

stage_b_combo_refit.selection_unit: postflop decision with an exact Model A runtime context

label_policy.hidden_private_hand: LATENT_POSTERIOR; never synthesize or guess one exact hand

latent_prior.source: Model A preflop exact-combo range reconstructed only from information strictly before the target postflop decision
latent_prior.initial_support: 1326 exact NLHE combos minus known public/Hero blockers
latent_prior.conditioning: preflop actions and earlier postflop actions only; target postflop action is forbidden when constructing its own latent private-hand assignment
latent_prior.street_transition: remove newly exposed board blockers, renormalize surviving exact combos, then condition on completed earlier actions

stage_b_combo_refit.fit_semantics: Each hidden observation contributes fractional sufficient statistics under its pre-action exact-combo posterior; each revealed observation contributes the corresponding point mass. This avoids showdown-only selection bias and target-action leakage.

regularization.principle: shrink incremental coefficients toward the parent; no unsupported context is materialized

backoff: parent v5 combo policy for insufficient effective weight
required_audits: board-blocker mass removed at each street

evaluation.primary_metric: population postflop action negative log likelihood on VALIDATION
evaluation.comparison: same VALIDATION decisions for baseline and candidate

scientific_decision.promote_candidate: primary VALIDATION delta < 0 and paired 95% CI upper bound < 0, with all coherence/leakage gates passing

continuation_contract.preflop_consumer: may explicitly load the candidate continuation artifact by immutable path/hash; no implicit replacement of Model A production postflop

stop_conditions: Any use of TEST for tuning or selection invalidates this run.
Any use of the target postflop action to infer its own hidden private hand invalidates Stage B.
Any silent nearest-context substitution or synthetic future/private card invalidates the affected observation.
No production model or pointer may be changed by this run.
